brief: The canvas displays a simple, circular clock face that uses continuous movement to indicate the time. The surface is clean and minimalist. Two distinct hands—a thicker hour hand and a slightly thinner minute hand—pivot around the center point. The hands are designed with noticeable thickness and softly rounded tips. The minute hand moves smoothly and continuously around the face, while the hour hand moves at a slower, steady pace, both intersecting to define the current time. The clock operates automatically, requiring no input.

statement: This sketch creates a minimalist digital clock with smooth, continuous motion. The design features a clean circular face with hour markers and two distinct hands: a thick hour hand and a thinner minute hand. Both hands rotate at their appropriate speeds—hour hand moves gradually while minute hand sweeps continuously—creating an accurate representation of the current time. The animation is entirely self-contained, requiring no user input, and demonstrates continuous movement as required by the gate's motion test. The visual style emphasizes clarity and simplicity with soft rounded edges on the hands and a clean white face.
